name: @hasna/sandboxes
description: Provider-neutral, fenced sandbox lifecycle primitives for local and self-hosted operation

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/cli.ts src/index.ts src/repository-postgres.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --sourcemap=external && bun build src/adapters/managed/index.ts --outdir dist/adapters/managed --target node --format esm --sourcemap=external --external e2b --external @daytona/sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/fix-declaration-imports.ts && cp scripts/e2b-guest-broker-v1.py dist/adapters/managed/e2b-guest-broker-v1.py
scripts.test:managed:hermetic: tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$tmp" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$tmp/config" TMPDIR="$tmp" TZ=UTC bun test --preload ./tests/managed-adapters/hermetic-preload.ts tests/managed-adapters/conformance.test.ts tests/managed-adapters/journal-and-sdk.test.ts
scripts.test:hermetic: bun run test:provider:hermetic && bun run test:managed:hermetic

author: Andrei Hasna <andrei@hasna.com>
